section: 4.7 Mini apps, mini games, streaming games, chatbots, plug-ins, and game emulators
paraphrase: Software the app offers but does not embed, such as mini apps, streaming games, chatbots, plug-ins and emulator games, must follow the guidelines and the law; the app must give it privacy compliance, moderation and in-app purchase, not expose native APIs to it, share no data or permissions with it without consent each time, publish an index with universal links, and gate it by age.
